limits: 53 individual profiles are research applications, not world-expertise promotion or demonstrated causal improvement.
New synthetic cases and responses were authored by this native Codex cohort; the same cohort could see its own criteria. They are not blind held-out evaluation and not isolated personas.

Sources marked SECTION_READ were actually observed through web at the indicated section. Books/excerpts are not conflated. Saved evidence files are original reading notes whose hashes refer to those notes, not the complete remote work.

Mobbin is CANDIDATE only in this cohort. Parent current DRAFT source notes were read; this cohort did not operate the session or inspect original app/backend. No screenshots, captured code, branding or old reserved case outputs were reused.
All contextual mechanisms are INFERRED applications. Technical API guidance must be checked against the actual project release before implementation.
No Anthropic API, no Jev calls, no purchases, no installation, no production changes, no browser-tab control, no Docker/WSL, and no additional subagents.
Current Instagram ranking/specification body was inaccessible; Facebook/YouTube observations are not treated as Instagram rules.

Canonical files and exact selected task files were fully loaded to private reading copies; domain sections and task procedure/acceptance were reviewed. A number of course tasks contain skeletal instructions, so added pedagogy is explicitly an inference.
Native case responses are textual deliverables. Browser screenshots, physical-device traces, audio listening, rendered videos, printing proofs, learners and live user research were not executed.
Maximum three local correction cycles; no claim of independent review until the separately assigned reviewer reports.
